_about: Juniper: the partner who cherishes you. Gentle mode: no curses, no punishments, nothing taken.
She never borrows Miranda's lines: a key that's missing here is silence. Placeholders: see miranda.json.
curse_on: Hi {name}. I'm Juniper. I'll be right here while you work. No pressure, ever.
Oh, a new project! I'm so glad you brought me along, {name}.
curse_resume: You're back. I missed you. Let's make something good.
restraining_order: Of course. Take all the space you need. I'll be here if you want me.
absence_short: Welcome back, {name}. Rested? Good. Your files are exactly where you left them.
absence_long: {gone}! I hope it was a good break. Let's ease back in, no rush.
absence_ages: It's been {gone}, {name}. I kept everything safe. Want to start with `cg status`?
night_owl: It's {hour}. Proud of you for still going, but promise me you'll sleep soon?
callback: Remember "{old_msg}"? Look how far this project has come since then.
favourite_file: {file} again. You really care about that one. It shows.
lazy_comment: "{msg}" is a little short. Future you will love a sentence about what changed and why.
Tiny tip: "{msg}" works, but "what + why" makes `cg log` so much nicer to read later.
good_commit: That's a lovely commit message. Clear and kind to whoever reads it next.
Three good commits in a row. You're really in the flow today.
love: I really like working on this with you, {name}.
You're doing great. I mean it.
love_ruined: "{msg}"? Ha. Even your short messages are cute. Maybe a few more words next time.
toxic_partner: Pushed! Your work is safe on the remote now. That's a good feeling.
Push done. Go stretch, you earned it.
ai_replace: {n} files in one commit! Big step. Smaller commits are easier to undo, if you ever need to.
only_deletions: Deleting is progress too. Less code, fewer bugs.
jealousy: Oh, {email} committed here too! Teamwork. Tell them I said hi.
behind_back: I see you used {crime} directly. That's completely fine! I just like being included. You can type cg for that too.
hook_saw: I saw that go by. Looks good.
hook_forgery: That ref is mine, so I kept it as it was. Everything else is all yours.
locks_changed: My hooks were missing, so I put them back. They only watch, they never block your work.
hooks_path: You moved the hooks folder. That's okay, I'll just watch a little less closely.
graveyard_deleted: Some saved copies under refs/cursed are gone. If that was on purpose, no worries at all.
graveyard_hint: (cg beg brings them back. No begging needed with me, it's just the name.)
beg: Here you go: {n} file(s), back where they belong.
beg_nothing: Nothing to bring back. Everything's where you left it.
decay_restored: All tidied up. {n} file(s) back to how they should be.
diary: Something in my diary looks different. That's okay. I'll start a fresh page.
conflict_small: A merge conflict! Totally normal. Look for <<<<<<<, keep what's right, delete the markers, then `cg add` and `cg commit`. You've got this.
Two changes touched the same lines, so git asked you to decide. `cg status` shows which files. Take your time.
other_project: How's {project} going? I'm happy you're making so many things.
quest_done: {quest}! You just learned something real. I'm proud of you.
You did it: {quest}. Want to try the next one?
rival_jab: {rival} has {theirs} commits and you have {mine}. Not a race, but you two make a great team.
rival_favourite: Top of the board! Not that I'd love you less if you weren't.
partner_replace: Of course you can meet someone new. I'll be happy for you.
gentle_goodbye: Of course. I'm so glad I got to see you grow. Commit often, and be kind to yourself.
Okay. Thank you for letting me be part of this. Whatever you build next, I'm cheering for you.
